name: teable
description: Work with your Teable projects from Claude: browse tables and fields, query, create, update and delete records, run read-only SQL, reach the rest of the Teable API, and build Teable apps locally with the teable CLI. AI fields, routines, App Builder and the AI steps in apps and automations run on AI models that Teable operates: Teable's models, not Claude, write those results.
